purpose: Reproduce and close the bounded ACIS 700 zero-record-count framing refusal in an AC1024 DWG, then qualify the corresponding bounded AC1024 SAT 700 serialization against ODA's independent DXF export without claiming 3D semantic support.

sat.provenance: Public cube SAT sample. The downloaded SAT remained under /tmp and was not committed as a fixture.

generatedDxf.operation: Created a 3DSOLID and assigned the SAT 700 lines to its SAT carrier.

odaRoundTripDxf.operation: Converted the generated AC1024 DWG back to ACAD2010 ASCII DXF; the 3DSOLID SAT carrier remains version 700.

extractor.integrityScope: The generated DWG has other reader integrity warnings; this receipt qualifies only the extracted modeler payload and parser framing behavior.

files.src/drw_acis.cpp: Admits a zero ACIS record count as unknown for version 700 only, matching the existing version-scoped 21200/21500/21800 behavior. Completion still requires the explicit terminal marker and full input consumption. The bounded SAT v1 serializer preserves SAT 700 only for AC1024, uses v700 @string, integer, pointer, and Boolean token spellings, and refuses the same carrier for AC1027.
files.tests/acis_sat_allocation_tests.cpp: Adds in-memory, locally generated ACIS 700 framing and serializer controls for integer/pointer spellings, plane-surface interval/sense booleans, coedge sense and straight-curve booleans. It verifies complete parsing, missing-terminal refusal, AC1024 conversion, atomic AC1027 refusal, and allocation-failure rollback with same-buffer retry. No external DWG/DXF/SAT fixture was added.

implementation.scopeLimit: Only the selected standard ACIS 7.00 carrier to AC1024 SAT 700 serialization is qualified. This does not establish DXF/DWG output admission, native B-rep validity, independent geometry semantics, other producer profiles, or a 3D support claim.

beforeChange.operation: drw_parseSabWithOutcome on the exact extracted payload
beforeChange.result: Rejected after 115 record starts and 1211 tags because header recordCount=0 was treated as a literal count.

afterChange.operation: drw_parseSabWithOutcome, drw_buildAcisModel, drw_extractAcisWireframeWithReport on the exact extracted payload

sat700SerializationComparison.comparison: Both streams have 1,297 whitespace-delimited SAT tokens. All entity/header tokens match except the creation time and the two header scalars whose exponent spellings differ but represent the same values. All 1,294 remaining tokens match exactly.
sat700SerializationComparison.independenceBoundary: ODA produced the reference AC1024 DWG and DXF; the SAT tokens were independently decoded from ODA's DXF with ezdxf 1.4.5. This is exact carrier serialization agreement for this one input, not independent B-rep or source-geometry semantic evidence.

generatedControl.result: PASS 1/1; generated complete terminal parsing, missing-terminal refusal, v700 SAT 700 token grammar, AC1024 serialization, atomic AC1027 refusal, exhaustive reached-allocation failure rollback, and same-buffer retry verified.

independentKernel.normalization: None; both original public SAT and exact hash-bound libdxfrw SAT output were parsed and lifted directly.
independentKernel.result: PASS for both inputs: ACadRust parsed SAT 7.0; OpenCADKernel lifted one body with one lump/shell, six faces/loops, 24 coedges, 12 edges and eight vertices; surface/curve/broken-reference loss was zero and body validation reported zero flaws.
independentKernel.limitations: This independently validates direct SAT 700 parsing and closed topology for the selected cube carrier. No independent expected dimensions, source DWG association, native source import, platform breadth or whole-document output is established. Probe and inputs remain scratch-only.

authorityBoundary.use: ODA describes DWG release-to-default SAT/SAB version mappings and the Autodesk-modified dialect boundary. The sample experiment is an ODA converter output observation only; it does not establish Autodesk producer behavior or resolve the separate ACIS 21500 header semantics.
authorityBoundary.semanticCeiling: Framing, structural inventory, and token-level AC1024 SAT 700 serialization agreement from one ODA-produced carrier. No independent geometry semantic oracle, B-rep kernel, native acceptance, output admission, or producer-wide version profile is established.

claimEffect: Closes the parser's bounded ACIS 700 zero-count framing refusal for streams with an explicit terminal marker and implements the selected AC1024 SAT 700 serializer profile. Does not promote DWG, DXF, ACIS/ACDS, or 3D support claims.
